app.title: Course setter
app.tagline: Set orienteering courses on your club's maps and print them at the right scale.

common.error: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.

auth.signInPrompt: Sign in with your Google account to see your clubs.

clubs.heading: Your clubs
clubs.empty: You are not in a club yet. Create one, or ask an admin of your club for an invite link.
clubs.createHelp: You become the club's first admin and can invite the other members.

club.notFound: This club does not exist, or you are not a member of it.

maps.heading: Maps
maps.emptyAdmin: Upload an OCAD or PDF map to start setting courses on it.
maps.emptyMember: Club admins upload the maps. They show up here when they are ready.
maps.processing: Version {{number}} ({{file}}) is being processed. This takes a minute or two.

errors.not_ocad: the file is not an OCAD map.
errors.unsupported_ocad_version: this OCAD format version is not supported. Save the map as OCAD 2018 or OCAD 12 and upload it again.
errors.not_pdf: the file is not a PDF.
errors.unreadable_file: the file could not be read. It may be damaged.
errors.processing_failed: something went wrong while processing it. Try uploading it again.

maps.notFound: This map does not exist, or it has no version you can see yet.
maps.deleteConfirm: Delete version {{number}} of {{map}}? Its files are removed for good.

upload.heading: Upload a map
upload.help: An OCAD (.ocd) or PDF map, up to 50 MB.
upload.name: Map name
upload.scaleHelp: A PDF does not store its scale. Give the scale the map is drawn at, for example 15000 for 1:15 000.
upload.ocadScale: The scale is read from the OCAD file.
upload.badScale: Give the scale as a whole number between 500 and 100 000.
upload.wrongType: Choose an OCAD (.ocd) or PDF file.
upload.tooLarge: The file is {{size}}; the limit is 50 MB.
upload.done: Uploaded. The map appears in the list when it has been processed.
upload.versionHelp: The new OCAD or PDF file of this map, up to 50 MB. It is lined up with the current version: automatically when the map's coordinates allow it, otherwise you match a few points.

maps.needsAlignment: Version {{number}} has to be lined up with the previous version before members can use it.

alignedBy.georef: Lined up with version {{number}} from the map's coordinates.
alignedBy.points: Lined up with version {{number}} from matched points, within {{rms}} m.

maps.uploadAbandoned: The upload of version {{number}} ({{file}}) did not finish. Open the map, choose this version, delete it and upload the file again.

events.heading: Events
events.emptyHelp: Create an event to set courses on one of the club's maps.
events.noMaps: Events need a map. Once one is uploaded, courses are set here.
events.createHelp: Only you, the club's admins and the people you invite can see it.
events.name: Name
events.deleteConfirm: Delete {{event}} and all its courses? This cannot be undone.
events.notFound: This event does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

members.heading: Members
members.name: Name
members.leaveConfirm: Leave {{club}}? You need a new invite link to come back.
members.lastAdmin: A club must have at least one admin. Make someone else admin first.

invites.heading: Invite links
invites.help: Anyone with a link can sign in with Google and join as member.
invites.shareHelp: Share the link in the club chat. People who open it sign in with Google and join as members.

settings.heading: Club settings
settings.nameHelp: Shown to members and on invite links.
settings.adminsOnly: Only admins can change the club settings.

invite.heading: Join a club
invite.signedOut: You have been invited to join a club on Course setter. Sign in with Google to see the invite.
invite.valid: You have been invited to join {{club}}.
invite.alreadyMember: You are already a member of {{club}}.
invite.expired: This invite link to {{club}} has expired. Ask a club admin for a new one.
invite.revoked: This invite link to {{club}} is no longer valid. Ask a club admin for a new one.
invite.unknown: This invite link is not valid. Check that you copied all of it, or ask a club admin for a new one.

viewer.measureHelp: Click on the map to measure; double-click to finish.

align.heading: Line up version {{next}} with version {{previous}}
align.help: Click a point on version {{previous}}, then the same point on version {{next}}: a path junction, a building corner, a boulder. Two pairs are enough; three or more, spread across the map, are better.
align.clickNext: now click the same point on version {{number}}
align.clickPrevious: now click the same point on version {{number}}
align.fitTwo: Two points always fit exactly. Add a third to check them.
align.notNeeded: This version has no previous version to line up with.
align.automatic: This version was lined up automatically. Match points only if it is off.

descriptions.help: Click a cell to choose a symbol. A description belongs to the control, so it shows in every course that uses it.
descriptions.hoverHint: Point at a symbol to see its name.

hint.select: Click a control to select it, then drag it or its number to move it. Delete takes it out of {{course}}.
hint.start: Click on the map to place the start{{inCourse}}.
hint.control: Click on the map to add a control{{inCourse}}, or click an existing one to use it again.
hint.finish: Click on the map to place the finish{{inCourse}}.
hint.crossingPoint: Click on the map to add a mandatory crossing point{{inCourse}}.
hint.bend: Click on a course line to bend it; drag a bend to move it, click it to remove it.
hint.placeSpecial: Click on the map to place a {{name}}.
hint.mapIssue: Click on the map to place the map issue point{{inCourse}}. The way from it to the start is a marked route.
hint.optionalCrossing: Click where the crossing is, then in the direction runners go through. It is not part of any course.
hint.markedRoute: Click to add points of the marked route{{inCourse}}, or click a marked route already in the event to use it again. Double-click or Enter finishes, Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
hint.drawSpecial: Click to add points of the {{name}}. Double-click or Enter finishes, Backspace removes the last point, Esc cancels.
hint.selectSpecial: Drag to move it, or drag one of its points. Shift+click adds a point on an edge or removes one. Delete removes it.
hint.selectAll: Click a control to select it, then drag it to move it. Delete removes it from the event.

editor.emptyCourse: No controls yet. Choose Start, Control or Finish in the tool bar and click on the map.
editor.emptyPool: No controls yet. Choose a tool and click on the map.

settings.name: Course name
settings.climbHelp: Shown on the description sheet, rounded to 5 m. Leave empty to leave it out.
settings.deleteConfirm: Delete the course {{course}}? Its controls stay in the event.

editor.deleteControlConfirm: Delete {{name}}? It is removed from every course.

conflict.heading: Someone else saved this event
conflict.body: {{name}} saved this event at {{time}} while you were editing. Your changes are not saved yet.
conflict.keepMineHelp: Saves your version. Theirs stays in the event's history.
conflict.useTheirsHelp: Saves your version as a copy of the event ({{copy}}), then opens theirs.
conflict.movedVersion: They also moved the event to another version of the map, so your changes cannot replace theirs. Use theirs: your version is kept as a copy on this map version.

access.heading: Who can see and edit {{event}}
access.creator: Created the event
access.everyone: Everyone in the club has access already.
access.leaveConfirm: Leave {{event}}? You need someone with access to invite you again.

editor.outsideMap: This point is outside the map.
editor.mapLabel: Map: click to place or select, drag a selected control to move it

newVersion.available: Version {{number}} of the map is available.
newVersion.notLinedUp: Version {{number}} of the map is available, but it is not lined up with this one yet, so the courses cannot be moved to it.
newVersion.heading: Move the courses to version {{number}}
newVersion.body: Every control and bend moves to the same place on the terrain on version {{number}}, using how that version was lined up. The event then uses version {{number}}.
newVersion.outside_one: This control ends up outside the new map: {{names}}. Check it after moving.
newVersion.outside_other: These controls end up outside the new map: {{names}}. Check them after moving.
newVersion.conflict: Someone else saved this event meanwhile. Close this and try again once their changes have loaded.

print.scaleHelp: The scale the course is printed at. Course symbols follow it, on the map too.
print.cellSizeHelp: Size of each square on the printed description sheet (IOF: 5 to 7 mm)
print.resetHelp: Place the page and the description sheet automatically again
print.hint: Drag the page to choose what is printed. Drag the description sheet to a free spot.
print.mapLabel: Map with the printed page: drag the page or the description sheet to move it
print.onePdf: One PDF, a page per course
print.saveFirst: Your changes are not saved yet, so the PDF cannot be made.
print.failed: Could not make the PDF of {{courses}}
print.downloadFailed: Could not download the file. Make a new PDF if it has expired.
